textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · Temperature and its Measurement · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Our sense of touch cannot give an exact temperature. Two hands can feel the same water differently if one hand was cooler beforehand. To measure how hot or cold something is, we use temperature.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Our sense of touch cannot give an exact temperature. Two hands can feel the same water differently if one hand was cooler beforehand. To measure how hot or cold something is, we use temperature.
beats.speakEn: Our sense of touch cannot give an exact temperature. Two hands can feel the same water differently if one hand was cooler beforehand. To measure how hot or cold something is, we use temperature.

beats.en: Temperature tells us how hot or cold an object is. Heat is energy transferred because of a difference in temperature. Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius.
beats.speakEn: Temperature tells us how hot or cold an object is. Heat is energy transferred because of a difference in temperature. Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius.

type: Key Concept: Our sense of touch cannot give an exact temperature.
Rule: Temperature tells us how hot or cold an object is.

textbookBox.concept: A clinical thermometer is designed to measure body temperature. Many modern clinical thermometers are digital, with a number shown on a display. Laboratory thermometers have different ranges.

beats.en: A clinical thermometer is designed to measure body temperature. Many modern clinical thermometers are digital, with a number shown on a display. Laboratory thermometers have different ranges.
beats.speakEn: A clinical thermometer is designed to measure body temperature. Many modern clinical thermometers are digital, with a number shown on a display. Laboratory thermometers have different ranges.

beats.en: Glass thermometers containing mercury are an older design. Do not handle one. Use an instrument your teacher provides for a science demonstration, such as a suitable mercury-free thermometer.
beats.speakEn: Glass thermometers containing mercury are an older design. Do not handle one. Use an instrument your teacher provides for a science demonstration, such as a suitable mercury-free thermometer.
